implementation_summary: CompactContextExecutor (id compact-context) is registered in the static dispatcher and every connection dispatcher after web-search and curl and before McpBridge, so MCP cannot reuse the name. In handleChatSend, after the existing budget/enablement/availability/id checks, a response containing compact_context is intercepted: toolCallCount += all calls; a sole call with valid args ends the turn with a neutral tool_result step and chat.done carrying compaction {toolCallStepId, summary, remainingWork?} with no further model invocation; a multi-call response or invalid args executes nothing, emits an error tool_result for every call and continues the loop (usedTokens already updated). BackendClient forwards chat.done.compaction to an optional onCompaction callback before resolving.
decisions: Validation is done by parseCompactContextArgs in the loop (never the dispatcher), so Ajv/exception paths cannot turn a bad compact_context call into chat.error; the executor's execute is a validating fallback never reached on the compaction path.

Existing check order is kept: budget check first (a rejecting response that would exceed maxToolCalls ends in the budget chat.error before any rejection side effect), then enablement/availability/id, then interception. 'Exhausted' therefore means the next response's calls would exceed the budget, identical to ordinary tools.
remainingWork is omitted when absent or whitespace-only; the summary is kept verbatim (not trimmed).
Unknown properties and non-string remaining_work are rejected as errors (schema additionalProperties false mirrors this). No maximum summary length is imposed.
Valid-call tool_result content is the neutral 'Context summary recorded.'; error tool_results are JSON {error: ...} with title 'Result: <name>' and toolResult.{id,name} of the call.

Transport: stream promise type unchanged (many callers/tests resolve to ConversationStep[]); payload reaches callers via optional StreamRequest.onCompaction invoked just before resolve. use-chat-generation is intentionally untouched; S6 wires onCompaction.
Guided tour unaffected: web_search stays first in the registry (builtinTools[0]); asserted in http-server.test.ts.
caveats: The client does not yet consume compaction (S6); use-chat-generation ignores it, so a compaction chat.done is currently appended like an ordinary done.
chat.done steps for a compaction contain the neutral tool_result; the compaction StepKind is S6.
